title: UnitRuntimeService
responsibility: Turns declared execution targets into working runtimes and selects the measured kernel default.

inputs.name: UnitRuntimeService.constructor.root
inputs.description: Filesystem root used to resolve relative target entries and to locate recorded measurements. Defaults to process.cwd().

inputs.name: UnitRuntimeService.constructor.options
inputs.description: Options passed to created adapters; timeoutMs controls adapter call deadlines, and env supplies kernel lookup variables instead of process.env when present. Defaults to an empty object.

inputs.name: UnitRuntimeService.forTarget.target
inputs.description: Execution target whose kind selects the adapter and whose entry supplies its URL, file path, or process command. Module handlers default to invoke, and slash-containing process entries are resolved beneath root.

inputs.name: UnitRuntimeService.forUnit.manifest
inputs.description: Component manifest whose runtime.targets are searched for the requested target kind. Its runtime.kind supplies the default kind, and its id is included in the missing-target error.

examples.title: UnitRuntimeService
examples.responsibility: Turns declared execution targets into working runtimes and selects the measured kernel default.

inputs.name: UnitRuntimeService.forUnit.kind
inputs.description: Runtime kind to match against manifest.runtime.targets. Defaults to manifest.runtime.kind.

inputs.name: UnitRuntimeService.kernel.kind
inputs.description: Kernel runtime to construct, or default to resolve through kernelDefault(). Missing Wasm or native artifacts and an unset HTTP kernel URL cause ExpectedCliError.

outputs.name: UnitRuntimeService.forTarget
outputs.description: Adapter selected for the supplied target, implementing UnitRuntime.invoke and close. Relative Wasm/module entries and slash-containing process entries resolve beneath root; process names without a slash pass through, and HTTP entries are used directly.

outputs.name: UnitRuntimeService.forUnit
outputs.description: Adapter for the first runtime target whose kind matches the requested or manifest default kind. ExpectedCliError is thrown when no matching target is declared.

outputs.name: UnitRuntimeService.kernelDefault
outputs.description: RuntimeChoice for representativeWorkload (graph-1k) and the current machine profile, based on recorded measurements. chooseRuntime prefers the simpler runtime within 5% and falls back to unmeasured module when no usable candidate exists.

examples.rule: Lowest median cold end-to-end latency on the representative workload for this profile; within 5% the simpler runtime wins (module, then wasm, then process). Unmeasured or unavailable runtimes are never chosen automatically.

excluded.reason: No measurement for this workload and profile.
No measurement for this workload and profile.
No measurement for this workload and profile.

outputs.name: UnitRuntimeService.kernel
outputs.description: UnitRuntime adapter for the selected kernel runtime; default resolves through kernelDefault(). Wasm and process require built artifacts, while HTTP requires HARNESS_KERNEL_URL.

errors.name: ExpectedCliError
errors.description: Thrown when forUnit cannot find a target of the requested kind, when a requested Wasm or process kernel artifact is not built, or when an HTTP kernel URL is unset.
